strings.en: Hm... lost them. ...It seems I charged too far ahead alone.
No choice. I'll regroup with Leina and the others...
...Hold, Rom Stol! You can't escape me.
Gardy... so you've appeared! I have questions for you.
About what Diondra said...? Fool, that was Diondra's scheme!
I know nothing of your brother!
...Is that true, Gardy!?
Ugh... gh...! Even if I were your brother,
I'm a Gyandlar commander! I won't let you stand in Lord Gades's way!
It can't be helped...!
Follow me, Rom! You and I... will settle this in a fitting place!
What!? Wait! Gardy!
Kenrou and Ryusei are fated to fight until one falls...!
I'll settle that fate once and for all!
(Yes, his sword... its connection to Kenrou concerns me too...)
Ooh, isn't this nice? The Nadesico's observation room.
What's up? What did you want to talk about, Kyosuke?
I just have a feeling... it's finally coming.
...Yeah.
Alchemie... she's probably...
...No doubt about it. What I feel from that girl...
No, maybe I should say from that machine...
...The reason they... the Einst took you...
I feel like we'll see the result of it soon...
...New life... that's the key, Kyosuke.
...!? New life? How much do you know?
When they took you away... what did they do to you?
That girl, Alchemie, is your...
Sorry, Kyosuke... I only know it in tiny fragments...
But... in that accident, the reason we survived was...
...I have some idea. But I'm not certain...
As I told everyone, it's only a guess.
...When you shielded me, Kyosuke...
I know the debris had already done me in...
So you knew... Yes.
But you didn't have a scratch... and I was fine too.
The ones who saved us were... the Einst...!?
I'm almost sure of it.
...But what if the reason was to take you away?
Me!? Then why were you...
...I don't know. But you were returned. Why, I can't say...
but couldn't it be because their goal had been achieved?
And the red machine I'd destroyed once... why it reappeared too...
That was... just an offshoot, you know.
Hm...? What do you mean?
I'm not really sure... but the Einst all come from a single source.
...What? Then the ones we've seen until now...?
...Hmm, you could say... they're like bees.
There's a queen bee, and she's what moves the rest... something like that?
So unless we defeat the queen bee, they'll keep coming endlessly?
I'm not confident that's right, though...
...It wants to destroy humanity by its will alone?
How do you know that much, Excellen?
...How to put it... I was one of those bees, too.
Bees...? Th-then, Kyosuke, if she'd stayed that way,
you'd have been eaten, wouldn't you...
That's mantises.
Wow, eavesdropping? That's in poor taste, Captain Yurika.
It's fine. ...That's why I came here in the first place.
Oh my, is that so?
Take what we just said... Omoikane, was it?
Feed it into this ship's central computer and get a predicted answer.
The more information we have, the better.
Roger.
Phew, good thing I didn't blurt out anything weird.
If Captain Yurika heard, it might've wrecked things with Tenkawa.
(I-is it really that racy...?)
Oh, I didn't open the channel to eavesdrop or anything.
...We've located the Gyandlar mothership.
Wow! So we know where Rom and co. went? Excellen is thrilled!
...Isn't the way you're talking kind of weird?
Is it?
No time for idle chatter. Understood, returning to the ship.
(More importantly, the Einst. Their movements are getting clearer...
and they've been getting stronger... If the queen bee builds up power,
it stands to reason her offspring grow stronger too... Tch.)
Lord Gades... Diondra and Gardy have failed to seize the treasure again.
Useless fools...
...Perhaps I should pose as one of Londo Bell myself...
...I can wait no longer! Advance this mobile fortress.
...Lord Gades, Diondra and the others are being pursued by Rom's lot...
To move now would be...
Isn't that all the more convenient? Heh heh heh...
Don't tell me... you'll face Rom yourself, Lord Gades...!?
I don't plan to stay in league with Garimos and the Bunker forever...
Isn't now the right time?
Besides, I've told Gardy to lure Rom and the others
over here... Heh heh heh heh...
As expected of Lord Gades... so shrewd...
